reviewed_by: Claude review of stale session-metadata assertions
reason: PR #447 began persisting the conversation's chosen MCP servers and hooks as session metadata (chat.py writes mcp_server_ids and hook_ids), but two assertions in tests/v3/test_chat.py compare session.metadata for exact equality and were not updated. Both have been failing on origin/main since that merge: test_durable_session_rejects_divergent_or_forged_history and test_existing_session_cursor_and_messages_roll_back_together. The product behaviour is intended, so the assertions now include the two new keys; nothing else changes. This unblocks every pull request whose receipt names test_chat.py.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: no ui/ change at all, so no area applies. Only a test file changes, so no other Python file is affected.
